title: Codex-to-Claude Worker Task Specification
description: Structured task spec dispatched by a Codex orchestrator to a Claude Code worker. Derived from worker-contracts.md "Worker calling contract" (table at lines 11-30) and the example in architecture.md lines 123-168.

kind.description: Optional classification (e.g. test, refactor, doc, analysis). Informational; does not drive policy.

role.description: Worker role; drives the default permission template.

workspace.description: Working directory. For a write task this is typically a per-task git worktree path (e.g. .claude/worktrees/T-0007).

session_id.description: Optional UUID minted by Codex so the Claude conversation can be resumed via --session-id / --resume.

allowed_paths.description: Paths the worker may read or write. Verified against changed_files in the result.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths the worker must not touch. Always includes secrets and global agent config (.env, .git/, .claude/, .codex/).

permission_mode.description: Claude permission mode. For unattended workers, only acceptEdits, plan, and dontAsk are normally selected; default and auto are unsafe in -p mode per security.md.

tools.description: Closed set of Claude built-in tools the worker may see (--tools). Omit to inherit Claude defaults.

allowed_tools.description: Pre-approved tool invocations (--allowedTools). Bash invocations use the scoped form, e.g. Bash(npm test *).

disallowed_tools.description: Denied tool invocations (--disallowedTools). Should always include Bash(git push *), Bash(git reset *), Bash(rm *) by default.

definition_of_done.description: Plain-English completion criteria. Each entry should be machine-checkable when possible.

verification_commands.description: Commands the worker (or wrapper) must run before declaring succeeded. Empty for pure reader roles.

output_schema.description: Path to a JSON Schema enforced via --json-schema. The wrapper also validates the parsed result against worker-result.schema.json.

handoff_notes.description: Background context Codex hands to the worker so it need not re-derive it. Must not contain secrets.

max_turns.description: Hard cap on agentic turns. Maps to --max-turns. Exceeding it yields result.subtype == "error_max_turns".

max_budget_usd.description: Hard cap on spend in USD. Maps to --max-budget-usd. Exceeding it yields result.subtype == "error_max_budget_usd".
